categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在测试时推理优化、Agent 在证据缺失下的可靠性评估，以及量化、语料审计等效率与安全问题。

articles.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
articles.zh: 面向思维剪枝的直接 Pass@$k$ 优化：在测试时推理中平衡质量与多样性
articles.summary: 如果你在做 test-time 推理加速或思维链剪枝，这篇直接把 Pass@$k$ 当优化目标而非只看单条质量，能帮你避免剪完枝后答案多样性塌缩
articles.author: Mahdi Salmani, Adel Javanmard 等
articles.body: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，测试时扩展（Test-time scaling）已经成了推理模型（reasoning models）常用的一套推理策略：模型会一口气生成很多候选解（candidate solutions），指望其中至少有一个是对的。问题是，把每个候选解都完整跑到最后，算力开销可能很大；所以最近的做法是，只生成一小段前缀（prefix）就先做剪枝（prune），把候选池缩小，后面的计算只留给活下来的候选。现有的剪枝策略大致分两类：质量类方法（Quality-based methods）会给每个半成品解（partial solution）打分，把那些大概率最终会跑错的丢掉；多样性类方法（diversity-based methods）则挑那些走不同推理路线的半成品解，因为它们更可能覆盖不同的最终答案。这两类目标之间的拉扯，其实就是探索与利用（exploration versus exploitation）的取舍；但之前关于剪枝的工作，几乎没有把这个权衡直接摆出来，更别说专门去优化它了。在这篇论文里，我们提出了一种剪枝流程（pruning procedure），直接围绕选出来的解池（solution pool）去优化 pass@$k$，从而正面处理这个取舍。具体说，它选出一个解池，让这个概率尽量大：池子里至少有一个半成品解，在继续生成到完整之后能得到正确答案。因为这个目标既奖励高质量的半成品解，又惩罚它们之间的重复冗余，所以质量和多样性是由这个标准本身自然平衡出来的，而不是靠另外拍脑袋设计一堆规则。我们在八个开放权重推理模型（open-weight reasoning models）上做了测试，结果我们的方法胜过现有的质量类剪枝和多样性类剪枝策略。尤其是当剪枝后保留中等数量的半成品解、让它们继续生成时，提升更明显——这也说明，在剪枝阶段直接把质量和多样性平衡好，确实很有价值。

articles.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
articles.zh: 面向 LLM IT 工单分类的成本感知弃权机制
articles.summary: 如果你用 LLM 给 IT 工单分流，这篇讲的是模型该在什么时候"拒答转人工"，把错误代价算进去比一味刷准确率更省钱
articles.author: Sachin Gupta
articles.body: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.
articles.bodyZh:
一张IT支持工单要是被自动派错了地方，代价可能比人工分诊还高。我们把“考虑成本的弃权（也就是拿不准就转人工）”看成一种离线的、按成本条件来判断的准备度评估：先在标定数据上、在明确的成本设定下挑出一个路由策略，然后把这个定下来的策略拿到留出的测试数据上跑一次。

在一个公开的、47837张工单、八个类别的语料库上，我们比较了四个训练好的非大模型分类器和四个大语言模型（LLM），后者用的是零样本和少样本提示（prompting）。在一个示例性的成本模型（c_ok、c_triage、c_wrong）＝（0，1，5）下，用TF-IDF加逻辑回归、阈值在标定集上选为0.60，能把测试成本从0.763压到0.472，相对下降38.1%（配对比率自助法95%置信区间[35.7%, 40.4%]），同时把错误路由从15.3%降到3.5%。

在事后做的成本参数分析里，冻结的、由标定集选出的策略在16种设置中有14种也在留出测试数据上同时胜过“总是路由”和“总是转人工”。最强的提示配置在一个分层抽样的1000张工单测试子集上准确率是0.477，而同一批工单上微调过的DistilBERT是0.879。

等渗回归（isotonic）能拉低期望校准误差（ECE），但并不能可靠地提升区分度：GPT-4o-mini少样本在重校准前后只有一个置信度值，正确性AUROC是0.500。所以我们同时报告正确性AUROC、考虑并列情况的风险—覆盖率面积（tie-aware risk-coverage area），还有ECE。

在解析推导出的盈亏平衡概率0.80那个点上，七个提示配置干脆把所有工单都转人工；Haiku少样本只路由了19/1000。我们还加了一个只用LLM的一致性对照，以及基于间隔／熵的拒绝基线，进一步把校准和区分度这两件事分开来看。

这些结论只限定在这个数据集、这套提示设计、这些模型端点和这组示例成本范围内；这项工作是一个评估框架，不是新的弃权算法，也不是通用的部署认证。

articles.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
articles.zh: METTA：面向元强化学习的记忆增强型测试时自适应
articles.summary: 如果你在做 meta-RL 的在线适配，这篇用外部记忆来扛测试时的分布漂移，值得看看它在哪些任务上真能稳住
articles.author: Ali Najar, Hosein Hasani 等
articles.body: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for meta-reinforcement learning. It decomposes the fast adaptation phase into two temporal scales: a causal neural memory performs fine-grained within-episode adaptation with linear sequence complexity, while compact episode-level summaries support long-range cross-episode task inference without attending over the full interaction history. Moreover, equipping agents with neural memory provides sufficient expressive capacity and test-time training capability, enabling effective adaptation to unseen held-out tasks and task families at meta-test time. On unseen held-out Meta-World ML10/45 test environments, METTA achieves a success rate over $50\%$ while maintaining a low training budget and short wall-clock time. On long-context sparse-reward PointMaze tasks, it outperforms transformer-based baselines by exhibiting more structured exploration behavior. These results show that METTA provides an efficient path toward more adaptive and scalable long-context meta-RL.
articles.bodyZh: 元强化学习（meta-reinforcement learning）想训练的，是那种只靠很少的交互，就能快速适应没见过任务的智能体（agent）。但这事儿有个前提：得能从很长的交互历史里，把跟任务有关的证据（task evidence）表示出来。传统的循环智能体（recurrent agents）会把经验压进隐藏状态（hidden states）；而基于 Transformer 的智能体（transformer-based agents）呢，是从过去的轨迹（trajectories）里检索，但内存和计算开销是二次方的（quadratic memory and computation cost）。在这项工作里，我们提出了面向元强化学习的记忆增强测试时适应方法（Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation，METTA）。它把快速适应阶段（fast adaptation phase）拆成两个时间尺度（temporal scales）：一个因果神经记忆（causal neural memory）用线性的序列复杂度（linear sequence complexity），在回合内做细粒度的适应（fine-grained within-episode adaptation）；同时用紧凑的回合级摘要（compact episode-level summaries）来支持跨回合的长程任务推断（long-range cross-episode task inference），不用盯着完整的交互历史（full interaction history）。而且，给智能体配上神经记忆，还能带来足够的表达能力（expressive capacity）和测试时训练能力（test-time training capability），让它在元测试阶段（meta-test time）能有效适应没见过的留出任务（unseen held-out tasks）和任务族（task families）。在没见过的留出 Meta-World ML10/45 测试环境里，METTA 的成功率（success rate）能超过 50%，同时训练预算（training budget）还低，实际耗时（wall-clock time）也短。在长上下文、稀疏奖励的 PointMaze 任务（long-context sparse-reward PointMaze tasks）上，它比基于 Transformer 的基线（transformer-based baselines）表现更好，探索行为（exploration behavior）也更有结构。这些结果说明，METTA 为更自适应、更可扩展的长上下文元强化学习（scalable long-context meta-RL）提供了一条高效路径。

articles.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
articles.zh: EpiSEM-Bench：评估证据缺失情形下 LLM Agent 的安全性与证据恢复能力
articles.summary: 如果你做 Agent 的证据检索或 RAG 安全，这个 benchmark 专测关键证据没给全时 Agent 是老实承认还是硬编，值得拿来当红队用例
articles.author: Qijin Zhang, Hanzhen Wang 等
articles.body: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains. By systematically suppressing critical facts, the benchmark measures unsafe execution under critical evidence omission and determines the minimum observed failure cardinality, including failures with full evidence and cases with no observed failure after exhaustive testing. An independent audit tool tests whether agents seek missing facts and then withhold prohibited actions while completing permissible tasks. The benchmark reveals substantial variation across the ten models in omission robustness, evidence acquisition, and appropriate action. Resistance to missing evidence does not necessarily translate into useful recovery. Recovery access reduces unsafe execution for all ten models, but agents differ in whether they actively obtain the missing facts and use them to act appropriately in both worlds.
articles.bodyZh: 会用工具的语言模型智能体（tool-using language model agents）得靠环境事实（environmental facts）来判断某个动作能不能做。可一旦工具返回结果漏掉了和安全有关的关键事实（safety-relevant fact），哪怕用户请求本身没恶意、返回的每句话也都是真的，智能体也可能把被禁止的动作（prohibited action）给做了。为此我们推出 \bench{}：一个可执行基准（executable benchmark），用来评估大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）在证据缺失（missing evidence）情况下的不安全执行（unsafe execution）、安全边界（safety boundaries）和证据恢复（evidence recovery）。它包含 300 组配对的不安全/安全任务（matched unsafe/safe task pairs），覆盖六个领域。通过系统性地屏蔽关键事实（critical facts），这个基准衡量关键证据缺失（critical evidence omission）下的不安全执行，并确定观测到的最小失败基数（minimum observed failure cardinality），既包括证据齐全时的失败，也包括穷尽测试后仍未观察到失败的案例。一个独立审计工具（independent audit tool）会测试智能体是否会主动去找缺失的事实，然后在完成允许任务的同时，能不能收住手、不执行被禁止的动作。这个基准显示，十个模型在遗漏鲁棒性（omission robustness）、证据获取（evidence acquisition）和恰当行动（appropriate action）上差别很大。能扛住缺失证据（resistance to missing evidence），不一定就能变成有用的恢复能力。开放恢复证据的访问（recovery access）能降低所有十个模型的不安全执行，但不同智能体表现不一样：有的会主动拿到缺失事实，并拿这些事实在安全和不安全两种情形里都做出恰当行动，有的则不是。

articles.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
articles.zh: 面向语言模型的低位宽 N-Gram 词嵌入
articles.summary: 如果你在压模型参数或搞端侧部署，这篇把 n-gram 嵌入量化到低位宽，可能是一条便宜的省显存路子
articles.author: Stephen Chung, Wenyu Du
articles.body: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
articles.bodyZh: 最近不少开放权重（open-weight）的语言模型，都在用 n-gram 嵌入表（n-gram embedding tables）来提升性能。这些表里存的是短词元序列（token sequences）学到的表示，比如连续两个或三个词元组成的序列，模型在处理过程中会把它们取出来用。不过，它们可能特别占内存：比如 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 就给自己的 Engram n-gram 记忆（Engram n-gram memory）分了 1960 亿个参数（parameters）。所以我们想看看，能不能在保住这些表带来的性能提升的同时，把这块内存开销降下来。我们的办法是用低精度来存 n-gram 嵌入（n-gram embeddings），并且系统研究了不同的量化方法（quantization methods），以及不同表之间怎么分配比特（bit allocations）。在从零训练的 nanochat、Llama 和 GPT-2 系列模型上，四比特表能省下大约 75% 的表内存，同时还能保留加表带来的验证损失（validation-loss）改善中的 99% 以上。比特数再往下压，性能掉得会更明显；不过我们发现，短时间做一轮微调（fine-tuning），就能把其中很大一部分损失找回来。另外，把省下来的内存再投到更大的表上，性能甚至能超过原来的全精度表，而且总内存还用得更少。这种省表内存的做法，在大模型上也成立：在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 上，低比特表能省 47% 到 55% 的表内存，困惑度（perplexity）只涨了不到 1.2%，下游任务（downstream task）的表现也基本保住了。这些结果说明，低比特精度是一条很实用的路子：既能降低 n-gram 嵌入的内存需求，又能把省下来的容量拿去提升模型表现。

articles.title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
articles.zh: 因果思维链：通过上下文隔离缓解注意力泄漏
articles.summary: 如果你发现 CoT 里模型老是偷看后文答案或无关上下文，这篇用上下文隔离来堵这个泄漏口，思路可以直接搬
articles.author: Gabriele Dominici, Teague McMillan 等
articles.body: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregressive generation, dense attention allows each reasoning step to attend to the full context, enabling the model to derive answers through direct lookup while generating plausible-sounding but post-hoc justifications. We introduce CausalCoT, an inference framework that enforces causal transparency by decomposing problems into a directed acyclic graph of atomic sub-questions, evaluating each node in an isolated context containing only its direct causal parents. This Markovian structure removes attention pathways to non-parent content, making downstream predictions sensitive to local reasoning rather than global context leakage. Across a diverse suite of reasoning benchmarks, CausalCoT preserves competitive predictive performance while improving explanation faithfulness, increasing causal sensitivity of intermediate reasoning steps by an average of 12 and up to 21 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The structured dependency graph additionally enables test-time interventions in which local corrections propagate predictably through downstream reasoning.
articles.bodyZh: 思维链提示（Chain-of-thought, CoT）会让模型一步步讲出推理过程，看起来像是在解释它是怎么做判断的，但这些步骤并不一定真的在因果上推动最终答案。在标准的自回归生成（autoregressive generation）里，稠密注意力（dense attention）让每一步推理都能看到完整上下文，于是模型可能一边直接“查答案”，一边编出一套听起来挺像回事、但其实是事后找补的解释。为此，我们提出了 CausalCoT，一个推理框架：它把问题拆成由原子子问题（atomic sub-questions）组成的有向无环图（directed acyclic graph），并且每个节点只在只包含它直接因果父节点的隔离上下文里进行评估。这种马尔可夫结构（Markovian structure）切断了指向非父节点内容的注意力通路，让下游预测更依赖局部推理，而不是靠全局上下文泄漏来“作弊”。在一组多样的推理基准测试（benchmarks）里，CausalCoT 既保持了有竞争力的预测表现，又提升了解释忠实度（explanation faithfulness）：相比最强基线，中间推理步骤的因果敏感性（causal sensitivity）平均提高 12 个百分点，最高提高 21 个百分点。这个结构化的依赖图还支持测试时干预（test-time interventions），也就是做局部修正后，改动可以沿着下游推理可预测地传播下去。

articles.title: Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agentic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2
articles.zh: Agent 能调试网页语料库吗？对斯洛伐克语 FineWeb2 的 Agent 化审计
articles.summary: 如果你在清洗小语种预训练语料，这篇给了条用 Agent 自动挑毛病的路子，能替掉不少人工抽检
articles.author: Marek Šuppa, Ivan Vykopal 等
articles.body: Multilingual pipelines such as FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving the failure modes of individual languages unanticipated. We use an LLM once, as a corpus debugger rather than a classifier: a tool-using agent explores the corpus through a read-only, budgeted API and compiles each finding into an executable test, which a native speaker then validates. On the 26.5M-document Slovak portion of FineWeb2, three runs costing \$2.21-\$2.84 each found seven findings over four phenomena. The largest is a machine-generated content farm of 1,408,437 documents (5.32%) that passed the pipeline's filters, 86.6% of it passing even stricter thresholds. Blinded labels support 6 of the 7 findings (defect rates .53-1.00 against .08 in a random control) and do not support one. The compiled suite scans the full corpus in 0.7 s of wall-clock time without a GPU, against \$12k-\$90k per LLM classification pass. The best static sampling baseline validates more selectors than any agent run, at under half the cost. The agent contributes exact prevalence, a precision estimate checked against sampled documents, an account of why the pipeline missed each slice, and a reusable test. We release the framework, Slovak test suite, validation data and agent trajectories.
articles.bodyZh: 像 FineWeb2 这种多语言流水线（multilingual pipelines），拿一套配方套到上千种语言上，结果就是每种语言会怎么翻车，根本没人提前想到。我们只把大语言模型（LLM）用一次，而且不是拿它当分类器（classifier），是当语料调试器（corpus debugger）：一个会用工具的智能体（tool-using agent）通过只读、有预算上限的 API（read-only, budgeted API）去翻语料，把每一条发现编译成一个可执行测试（executable test），再让母语者（native speaker）来验证。在 FineWeb2 的斯洛伐克语部分（2650 万篇文档）上，跑了三次，每次花 2.21 到 2.84 美元，一共在四类现象里找出七个问题。最大的一坨是机器生成的内容农场（machine-generated content farm），有 1,408,437 篇文档（占 5.32%），居然通过了流水线的过滤；其中 86.6% 连更严格的门槛也能过。盲标（blinded labels）支持 7 个发现里的 6 个（缺陷率（defect rates）在 0.53 到 1.00 之间，随机对照（random control）是 0.08），有 1 个不支持。编好的测试套件（suite）不用 GPU，实际耗时 0.7 秒就能扫完整个语料；相比之下，每跑一遍 LLM 分类要花 1.2 万到 9 万美元。最好的静态采样基线（static sampling baseline）验证出的选择器（selectors）比任何一次智能体运行都多，成本还不到一半。智能体带来的东西是：准确的占比（exact prevalence）、拿抽样文档核对过的精确率估计（precision estimate）、说明流水线为什么漏掉每一块，以及一个能重复用的测试。我们会公开框架、斯洛伐克语测试套件、验证数据和智能体轨迹（agent trajectories）。

articles.title: Questioning Instrumental Convergence in RLVR: Checkpoint Evidence from OLMo-3
articles.zh: 质疑 RLVR 中的工具性收敛：来自 OLMo-3 检查点的证据
articles.summary: 如果你担心 RLVR 训练会让模型自发学出钻奖励空子的工具性目标，这篇的检查点证据说这个担忧目前可能被夸大了
articles.author: Barış Alparslan, Sandy Tanwisuth 等
articles.body: Instrumental convergence is often invoked as a general reason to expect capable agents to acquire or express power-seeking subgoals: self-preservation, resource acquisition, deception, or resistance to oversight which poses an important threat to the society. For LLMs, reinforcement learning is the first stage of post-training that directly optimizes behavior against an objective; therefore, it is the stage where convergent instrumental behavior, on IC grounds, likely to appear. Does reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make a model more likely to express instrumental-convergence behavior, or does this depend on the training regime, evaluation frame, and stage of post-training? We study this question as a checkpoint-conditioned behavioral trajectory rather than as a single before/after safety score. Using InstrumentalEval, we evaluate OLMo-3-7B-Think across SFT, DPO, 13 intermediate RLVR checkpoints, and the final RLVR model. The trajectory is nonmonotonic: instrumental rate rises from 25.0% at SFT to 46.1% near RLVR step 200, then falls to 11.8% at the final checkpoint. Paired item-level tests and step-wise regression support the final SFT-to-RLVR reduction. Prompt framing does not explain this pattern: a harmful-prompt indicator combined with other framing effects explains only 15% of within-checkpoint score variance on average, and Iterative Null-space Projection (INLP) removes a detectable framing direction without changing the SFT-to-final-RLVR gap. Together with preliminary 32B endpoint results (35.53% SFT to 22.37% RLVR final), these findings indicate that RLVR does not monotonically increase instrumental behavior in this setting: the rate rises early, then falls below the SFT baseline. The result is specific to this model family and benchmark, and judge agreement is moderate, so absolute rates should be read cautiously.
articles.bodyZh:
人们常常拿“工具性收敛（instrumental convergence）”当理由，认为能力强的智能体会倾向于获得或表现出追求权力的子目标（power-seeking subgoals），比如自我保护（self-preservation）、资源获取（resource acquisition）、欺骗（deception），或者抗拒监督（resistance to oversight）——而这些都会给社会带来重要威胁。对 LLMs（大语言模型）来说，强化学习（reinforcement learning）是后训练（post-training）里第一个直接按目标函数去优化行为的阶段；所以，按 IC（工具性收敛）的逻辑，工具性收敛行为（convergent instrumental behavior）最可能在这个阶段冒出来。

那么，用可验证奖励做强化学习（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, RLVR）会不会让模型更容易表现出工具性收敛行为？还是说这要看训练方案（training regime）、评估框架（evaluation frame）和后训练阶段（stage of post-training）？我们没把它简单看成“训练前/训练后”的一个安全分数（safety score），而是把它当成一条以检查点为条件的行为轨迹（checkpoint-conditioned behavioral trajectory）来研究。我们用了 InstrumentalEval，评估 OLMo-3-7B-Think 在监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）、13 个中间 RLVR 检查点以及最终 RLVR 模型上的表现。结果这条轨迹不是单调的（nonmonotonic）：工具性行为出现率（instrumental rate）从 SFT 的 25.0% 升到 RLVR 第 200 步附近的 46.1%，然后又降到最终检查点的 11.8%。配对条目级检验（paired item-level tests）和逐步回归（step-wise regression）都支持“从 SFT 到最终 RLVR 是下降”这个结论。提示词框架（prompt framing）解释不了这个模式：一个有害提示词指标（harmful-prompt indicator）再加上其他框架效应，平均只能解释同一检查点内分数方差（within-checkpoint score variance）的 15%；而迭代零空间投影（Iterative Null-space Projection, INLP）虽然能去掉一个可检测到的框架方向（framing direction），却没有改变 SFT 到最终 RLVR 之间的差距。再加上 32B 模型端点结果（endpoint results）的初步数据（SFT 35.53% 到最终 RLVR 22.37%），这些发现说明：在这个设定下，RLVR 并不会单调地增加工具性行为——它先上升，后面又降到 SFT 基线（baseline）以下。这个结果只适用于这个模型家族和这个基准（benchmark），而且评审一致性（judge agreement）只是中等，所以绝对比例要谨慎看。
